aboutMe: I'm a Tech Lead DevOps Engineer with over 15 years of experience in IT, managing multicultural global teams and leading cloud transformation initiatives. My expertise spans retail, banking, and enterprise technology, where I've successfully integrated Development, Operations, and Security teams through innovative pipeline solutions. I specialize in leading technical teams, defining cloud architecture strategies, and driving DevOps culture adoption across organizations of all sizes to achieve fast, secure, and scalable deployments.
